topic: the negative skill space concept: 12-axis gap mapping of skills and documents (audience, inputs, outputs, mode, assumptions, adjacent problems, failure modes, lifecycle, composition, knowledge sources, calibration, recursion) as a systematic gap-finder

subtopics.scope: The negative skill space definition: positive vs negative space of an artifact, the Rumsfeld known/unknown taxonomy applied to skills, and the discipline of moving unknown-unknowns into known-unknowns.
